document.abstract: In the dynamic landscape of the media and entertainment industry, the quest for efficiency and optimization is perpetual. As we stand on the cusp of a new era, AI and ML technologies promise to revolutionize the way we handle, process, and monetize media content. The challenges are evident, but so are the solutions, provided we know where to look.
